verdict.rationale: HumanLayer's docs show some product operations driven by natural language: an example plain-English prompt that configures a multi-repository workspace, and asking the session agent to open a draft PR. Most of the product, such as task creation, workflow selection and host selection, is documented through UI selections, config files or CLI rather than natural-language commands. missing for 10: documentation that NL commands cover product operation broadly (tasks, workflows, hosts, integrations), a dedicated natural-language control interface, independent/hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Configure a multi-repository workspace with this repository, ../api, and ../web. Make ../web the primary repository. Ask me before you choose setup commands or local files to copy.
Ask the session agent to open a draft pull request from the GitHub tab or diff view.
